text:
ana: Quick postmortem follow-up from last night's kv-cache incident — we need owners for the testing/evals items. I'll list proposals, assign if you can.

michael: I can take the regression harness for kv-cache (unit + integration). ETA 2w. I'll open a PR and add a CI job.

sophie: I'll own prompt-set additions for chat fallback behavior. Will add ~30 prompts including edge failure cases. ETA 10d.

rachel: ops: I'll add a chaos drill cadence to the eng-sre calendar — monthly to start for the next 3 months.

tony: Proposal: add a load test for bursty short sequences to Redwood Optimize pipeline (simulate many short, high-QPS requests). I'll pair with @michael on metrics.

zana: Thanks — can we also capture alert/metric tweaks and acceptance criteria? Link the tracker after assigning.

michael: TODOs I'm creating now: `regression/harness/kv-cache` job in CI, a simulated kv-miss injection test, CI gate threshold = 0.2% token error. Will @mention teams in the PR.

sophie: For prompts I'll start a prompt set in the evals repo: `incident/kv-cache/fallback_prompts.md`. Will add expected outputs, failure labels, and a tiny eval runner.

rachel: Ops action: increase sampling of failed completions by 5x for 24h after any serving deploy. I'll own this change. ETA 3d.

tony: Also suggest a scheduled chaos-drill that kills a single serving shard during steady traffic for 15m; observe routing fallback and latency spike. I'll draft the playbook.

zana: Can we make measurable acceptance criteria? e.g. regression must catch the simulated kv-miss, load test keeps p95 < 250ms, chaos drill restores routing within <60s.

michael: I will add a test that injects kv-cache-miss at 10% and asserts fallback success rate >= 99% and no token corruption.

sophie: I'll include adversarial prompt variants and an automated daily canary eval hook.

rachel: Scheduling detail: monthly chaos on first Tue, friction window 09:00-12:00 PT. I'll add calendar invites and on-call handoff notes.

zana: Action owners recap (I'll paste into postmortem doc):
- michael: regression harness + CI gate (ETA 2w)
- sophie: prompt set + eval script (ETA 10d)
- rachel: alert tweak + chaos schedule (ETA 3d)
- tony: load test addition + chaos plan (pairing) (ETA 2w)
I'll update the postmortem tracker and ping next week for status.

incident-bot: Postmortem updated: https://redwood/internal/postmortems/kv-cache-2026-03-21

deploy-bot: FYI — when tests are green you can request a staged deploy via /deploy.

ana: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
